stemMd: Choose the clearest revision preserving the stated timing: "The lights were installed after the painters finished painting the hallway."

options.label: A
options.textMd: The lights were installed after the painters finished the hallway.

options.label: B
options.textMd: The lights were installed while the painters worked.

options.label: C
options.textMd: The lights were installed because the hallway had lights.

options.label: D
options.textMd: The painters finished after the lights were installed.

explanationMd: Preserve the after relationship while removing the repeated painters/painting idea. The shorter sentence retains the sequence and makes the referent of the work clear.

distractorRationale.b: This changes successive events into overlapping events.
distractorRationale.c: This replaces the timing with a circular explanation.
